race.comment: G3 Bendigo Cup and KINGS VALLEY (6) will attempt another last-ditch effort to sneak into the Melbourne Cup. He'd have to win dominantly to gain a penalty big enough but that aside, he was very good in the Caulfield Cup two back then ran on strongly on Saturday in the G2 Moonee Valley Gold Cup. That was a slow tempo so he should have something in the tank on the quick backup. SO YOU ARE (4) is flying in Sydney with three straight wins, too good on a moderate tempo winning the G3 St Leger last time. Gets every hope from the inside gate. LITZDEEL (8) continues to race very well but not quite able to break through. She ran on strongly at Flemington then was good in the Geelong Cup which looks a good form race. Lane on helps. SUNTORA (7) just missed Pinhole in the Herbert Power and will be running on strongly. THE EUPHRATES (2) started favourite in the Geelong Cup but couldn't handle the pressure from Point Of Law and dropped out. Big weight here but he can bounce back.
